answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 167875 Country: India Title: Praying 4 Rakats of Nafl with One Salam: Is It Permissible? Question: Can we pray 4 rakats of nafl with only one salam for example ishraq namaz? Can we pray 4 rakats with only one salam like we pray 4 rakat Sunnah of Zuhr? Answer ID: 167875 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 597/493/B=05/1440) You may offer four rakah nafl salah with one salam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
